title: Symbol lifting commutes with execution
statement: Let $e$ be an injection of the Boolean alphabet into an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $D$ be a configuration of the one-tape machine over $\Gamma$ in the fixed input $x$, and let $t$ be a nonnegative integer. Running the symbol-lifted decrement machine from $D$ for $t$ steps gives the same configuration as first decoding the symbols of $D$, running the Boolean decrement machine for $t$ steps, and then lifting that run over $D$ along $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $D$ of the one-tape machine over $\Gamma$ with fixed input $x$
